dct_description_sm:
Data used for the Vacant Urban Residential Land Survey (VURLS) which monitors the supply of vacant land in Ottawa's urban area to assess whether it meets the policies of the Official Plan and the Provincial Policy Statement. The survey has been undertaken annually since 1982. View the Report: http://ottawa.ca/en/city-hall/get-know-your-city/statistics-and-economic-profile/update-2015

Accuracy: Points derived from the centroid of shapes originally based on parcel fabric at the time of creation

Update Frequency: As needed

Contact: Planning, Infrastructure & Economic Development / GIS and Data Management
dct_title_s: Vacant Urban Residential Land Survey Update 2015
